name: PS4: GoldHEN + FTP ready (wake → load → start FTP → verify :2121)
description: With an already-enabled BIN loader: wake the PS4, load goldhen.bin, then load ftp_server.bin and succeed when port 2121 (FTP) is open so you can immediately browse the PS4 from the File Ops tab.
notes: The last port check has no retry: the run fails if FTP never comes up. Requires your own compatible goldhen.bin (and ftp_server.bin for the FTP template). These templates cannot bootstrap a jailbreak from a closed BIN-loader port.

steps.name: Check GoldHEN port 9020 (retry wake on fail)
Wait 4 seconds for jailbreak to settle
Wait 3 seconds for FTP to bind

author: P5 Manager
